facts.text: The building was built in 1895 in a neo-classical style.
facts.excerpt: The majestic structure was built in 1895, in a neo-classical style.

facts.text: The building was designed by Ottoman architect Hovsep Aznavur and commissioned by philanthropist Migirdiç Sanasaryan.
facts.excerpt: Designed by Ottoman architect Hovsep Aznavur and commissioned by philanthropist Migirdiç Sanasaryan

facts.text: The han was once an office building whose rents were all paid into a foundation for the Sanasaryan School.
facts.excerpt: the Han Inn lived as a building full of offices where all rents were paid into a foundation for Sanasaryan School.

facts.text: The hotel displays a curated collection of artifacts and antique books, honouring its heritage as a beacon of education.
facts.excerpt: honouring its heritage as a beacon of education and with a curated collection of artifacts & antique books waiting to be discovered.

facts.text: A grand chandelier takes centre stage in the hotel's light-bathed atrium.
facts.excerpt: Within the light-bathed atrium of the Sanasaryan Han - a grand chandelier takes centre stage

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Istanbul's historic Old Town.
facts.excerpt: In the heart of Istanbul’s historic Old Town, Sanasaryan Han has stood proudly since 1895.

facts.text: The Spice Bazaar, Grand Bazaar, Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia and Karaköy are within walking distance.
facts.excerpt: The Spice and Grand Bazaar, Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia and Karaköy are within walking distance.

facts.text: The hotel is minutes from Galataport Istanbul and its international cruise terminal.
facts.excerpt: Located just minutes from Galataport Istanbul, Sanasaryan Han offers effortless access to the city's vibrant waterfront and international cruise terminal.

facts.text: The walls display monochromatic photographs of Istanbul by photographer Harun Doğan.
facts.excerpt: Adorning the walls is a series of monochromatic photographs of Istanbul by Turkish photographer Harun Doğan

facts.text: Rooms have marble bathrooms with handmade copper trays and traditional hammam bowls inspired by the Turkish bath ritual.
facts.excerpt: marble bathrooms with handmade copper trays and traditional hammam bowls inspired by the tradition of the Turkish bath ritual

facts.text: Every room has a Turkish tea set with the hotel's own tea blends, served in traditional glass cups and copper plates.
facts.excerpt: Each accommodation in Istanbul has a Turkish tea set featuring aromatic tea blends from the Sanasaryan Han to be enjoyed in traditional glass cups and copper plates.

facts.text: Beds have Turkish motifs and Frette linens.
facts.excerpt: From the plush bed with Turkish motifs and premium Frette linens

facts.text: Rooms have high ceilings.
facts.excerpt: The high ceilings and spacious large rooms feature serenity in the heart of the Old City.

facts.text: The Sanasaryan Han Suite's Atrium Living room has views of old Istanbul.
facts.excerpt: With breathtaking views of old Istanbul, the Atrium Living room is a sanctuary of style

facts.text: The Sanasaryan Han Suite has a black piano bar.
facts.excerpt: A black piano bar offers a nostalgic nod to the regency of the past, while designer furniture ensures contemporary comforts and panache.

facts.text: Guests are welcomed in the room with traditional hard candy, Turkish delight and almond paste.
facts.excerpt: guests are welcomed in the room with epicurean sweet tastes of Türkiye. Traditional hard candy, delicious Turkish delight and exquisite almond paste starts the transformative journey.

facts.text: Bathroom amenities have an exclusive scent of saffron, sandalwood, rose oil, papyrus, patchouli, oud, amber and labdanum.
facts.excerpt: Signature amenities are exclusively designed with an unforgettable scent of saffron, sandalwood and rose oil, ancient papyrus, patchouli, oud, amber and labdanum.

facts.text: Every day a dedicated Tea Master explains the origins and characteristics of tea leaves.
facts.excerpt: Every day, a dedicated Tea Master explains the origins & characteristics of the tea leaves, sharing stories about daily life in Turkey.

facts.text: The Library Bar hosts weekly cultural events such as poem readings, book presentations and live performances.
facts.excerpt: The Library Bar is a lively space that hosts weekly thespian events, expressing culture through various art forms such as poem readings, book presentations, and live performances.

facts.text: Guests get a weekly invitation to make their own clotted cream Turkish delight at the Hacı Bekir atelier, steps from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: we offer a weekly invitation to guests to be immersed in the art of cultivating their own clotted cream Turkish Delight.

facts.text: The hotel's tour of authentic Istanbul begins at the Grand Post Office, designed by architect Vedat Tek in 1905.
facts.excerpt: The journey begins at one of Europe’s most historic buildings -the Grand Post Office, designed by architect Vedat Tek in 1905.

facts.text: The Executive Chef runs a monthly Epicurean Workshop.
facts.excerpt: Embark on a monthly culinary voyage with our monthly Epicurean Workshop, curated by our esteemed Executive Chef.

facts.text: Siran Restaurant offers a seven-stage tasting menu paired with local wines.
facts.excerpt: Siran Restaurant takes the 'fine dining' experience to higher levels with its seven-stage exclusive tasting menu paired with local wines, in addition to its signature dishes.

facts.text: Siran Terrace serves contemporary cuisine and signature beverages in a garden setting.
facts.excerpt: Siran Terrace offers contemporary cuisine, refined seasonal flavors, and signature beverages in a tranquil garden setting.

facts.text: The hotel does not offer on-site parking.

facts.text: Room service is available 24 hours a day.
facts.excerpt: Room service is available 24 hours a day for your convenience.
